Cargo.toml.text:
[workspace]
exclude = ["rust/python"]
members = ["rust/core", "rust/geometry", "rust/geometry-runtime", "rust/processing", "rust/clash", "rust/ffi", "rust/export", "rust/wasm-bindings", "rust/landxml", "rust/cloud-import", "rust/testkit", "apps/server"]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.package]
version = "21.4.0"
edition = "2021"
authors = ["IFC-Lite Contributors"]
license = "MPL-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite"

[workspace.dependencies]
ifc-lite-core = { version = "21.4.0", path = "rust/core" }
# `default-features = false`: geometry's default set is empty, and the members that
# spelled it out (processing, wasm, server) said so to keep it that way.
ifc-lite-geometry = { version = "21.4.0", path = "rust/geometry", default-features = false }
ifc-lite-processing = { version = "21.4.0", path = "rust/processing" }
ifc-lite-clash = { version = "21.4.0", path = "rust/clash" }
ifc-lite-export = { version = "21.4.0", path = "rust/export" }
ifc-lite-wasm = { version = "21.4.0", path = "rust/wasm-bindings" }
ifc-lite-landxml = { version = "21.4.0", path = "rust/landxml" }

# Third-party dependencies declared by more than one member. A member opts in
# with `dep.workspace = true` and may only ADD features (`features = [...]`) or
# `optional = true`; it cannot turn default features back on or off, which is why
# `tracing` is declared with `default-features = false` here and the members that
# want `std`/`attributes` list them. A dependency used by a single member stays in
# that member's manifest. Bump a version here and every member follows.
arrow = { version = "60", default-features = false, features = ["ipc"] }
geometry-predicates = "0.3"
memchr = "2.8"
mimalloc = "0.1"
nalgebra = { version = "0.35", default-features = false, features = ["std"] }
parquet = { version = "60", default-features = false, features = ["arrow"] }
png = "0.18"
rayon = "1.10"
rustc-hash = "2.1"
serde = { version = "1.0", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0"
sha2 = "0.10"
thiserror = "2.0"
tokio = "1"
tracing = { version = "0.1", default-features = false }
# zip 9.0.4, not 8: every 8.x (and 9.0.0-9.0.2) release is yanked, so a crate
# published against `^8` cannot be resolved fresh by a downstream user or by the
# semver gate (#7737). The floor is the version the lockfile tests.
zip = { version = "9.0.4", default-features = false, features = ["deflate"] }

# Numeric-safety policy, inherited by every member via `[lints] workspace = true`.
# clippy must not auto-rewrite numeric literals or float comparisons: `.clamp()`,
# `RangeInclusive::contains`, and `partial_cmp` change NaN/panic behavior, and the
# precise literals in numeric code are intentional. Structure lints that only the
# geometry kernel needs are allowed in rust/geometry/Cargo.toml, not here, so the
# gate stays strict for the parser, server, and exporters.
[workspace.lints.clippy]
excessive_precision = "allow"
manual_range_contains = "allow"
manual_clamp = "allow"
neg_cmp_op_on_partial_ord = "allow"
approx_constant = "allow"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3           # Optimize for speed
lto = true              # Link-time optimization
codegen-units = 1       # Better optimization (slower compile)
strip = true            # Strip symbols
panic = 'abort'         # Smaller panic handler
overflow-checks = false # Remove overflow checks in release

[profile.release.package."*"]
opt-level = 3
strip = true

# Server-only release profile: re-enables stack unwinding so a panic while
# parsing untrusted, attacker-supplied IFC bytes on a `spawn_blocking` thread
# becomes a per-request `JoinError` (mapped to HTTP 500) instead of aborting
# the whole multi-tenant process. The default `release` profile keeps
# `panic = 'abort'` so the wasm bundle stays small.
# Built via `cargo build --profile server-release` (see apps/server/Dockerfile).
[profile.server-release]
inherits = "release"
panic = "unwind"

# Profiling profile: release-grade optimization with symbols retained and
# panic=unwind, so `samply record` on a profiled binary produces a symbolized
# flamegraph and per-element `catch_unwind` isolation still fires. Used by the
# `perf_probe` harness and `scripts/perf/flame.sh` (see `scripts/perf/README.md`).
# `strip`/`debug` override the release defaults; the rest is inherited.
[profile.profiling]
inherits = "release"
strip = false
debug = "line-tables-only"
panic = "unwind"


[profile.dev.package.bnum]
opt-level = 3
[profile.dev.package.num-bigint]
opt-level = 3
[profile.dev.package.num-rational]
opt-level = 3

[profile.dev.package.ifc-lite-geometry]
opt-level = 3

rust/geometry/Cargo.toml.text:
[package]
name = "ifc-lite-geometry"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
repository.workspace = true
description = "Geometry processing and mesh generation for IFC models"
keywords = ["ifc", "bim", "geometry", "mesh", "aec"]
categories = ["graphics", "parsing"]
readme = "../../README.md"

[features]
# Opt-in #6516 route-work diagnostic; absent from shipping builds.
opening-perf-trace = []
# CSG runs on the in-tree pure-Rust exact mesh-arrangement kernel
# (`src/kernel/`) on every target — native and wasm32 alike. The former
# Manifold C++ kernel (`manifold-csg` / `manifold-csg-wasm-uu`) and the
# legacy BSP port were removed in the kernel consolidation
# (docs/architecture/geometry-pipeline.md).
default = []
debug_geometry = []
# Measurement-only: record the (host, cutters) of every kernel subtract into a
# global buffer so a bench can replay the real CSG corpus under varying thread
# counts. Zero cost when absent. See src/csg_capture.rs.
csg_capture = []
# Structured diagnostics: routes the production warn/debug messages through
# `tracing` (structured fields, subscriber-controlled) instead of eprintln.
# Default OFF so default builds carry no tracing code in this crate; the
# native server enables it (via ifc-lite-processing/observability) so
# geometry-crate diagnostics land in its existing tracing subscriber.
# See src/diag.rs for the warn-vs-debug gating policy.
observability = ["dep:tracing"]
# Test-only differential oracle: makes `earcut` available ALONGSIDE the production
# `earcutr` as a second, independent triangulator, so
# `tests/triangulation_invariance.rs` can feed the pipeline two equally valid
# triangulations of the same polygons. Never enabled in a shipping build.
triangulation-alt = ["dep:earcut"]
# Test-only: exposes `test_support` (the receive-and-diagnose watchdog used by
# the termination suites) to OTHER crates' integration tests, which cannot see
# this crate's `cfg(test)` tree, and makes `mesh_check` `pub` so the shared
# `ifc-lite-testkit` mesh oracles can delegate to it. `ifc-lite-processing`
# (as a dev-dependency) and `ifc-lite-testkit` enable it. Never enabled in a
# shipping build.
test-support = []
# #3440 step 2: turns `csg/mod.rs`'s four boolean-op accept paths' informational
# open-topology check (step 1, always on) into a REJECT — a torn kernel result
# falls back exactly like an existing `KernelOutputInvalid`. Off by default and
# enabled by NOTHING downstream (no other crate in this workspace turns it on,
# unlike `observability`, which the native server does enable) — deliberately
# so this stays a `cargo test/build --features csg_topology_gate` opt-in for
# CI/census measurement, not a change to what any shipping build accepts. The
# repo's own watertightness census reports a nonzero count of currently-torn
# hosts on the un-gated default (see issue #3440's measurements), so enabling
# this by default today would reject geometry that currently renders.
csg_topology_gate = []
# #3440 step 3, and NOT on by default either. Turns the edge-multiplicity check
# (`edge_multiplicity_defects`: an undirected edge used by more than two
# triangles, or twice the same way round) into a REJECT at the same four accept
# paths. Separate from `csg_topology_gate` on purpose: the two read different
# defect classes, and a census run needs to attribute a flip to one of them, not
# to whichever gate happened to fire first.
#
# It was TRIED as a default. It reads a defect class benign tessellation cannot
# produce, and over the fixture corpus (115 models, 2071 void hosts) it rejects
# 110 hosts, all of which a downstream fallback still cuts — which looked like
# enough to ship. It is not: on this repo's own pinned quality fixtures the
# fallback is WORSE than the torn result it replaces. `issue_098_reveal_wall`
# goes from ~42 to 380 unpaired edges, `issue_098_v5c` from ~108 to 416, and
# `issue_960_segmented_roof_clip` grows back the full-height seam sliver that
# test exists to catch. Rejecting a tear is only an improvement if what replaces
# it is better, and here it is not — so this stays an opt-in until the fallback
# path is the one that gets fixed.
csg_manifold_gate = []

[dependencies]

# Triangulation
earcutr = "0.5"
# Differential oracle only, behind `triangulation-alt`. Present to be DIFFERENT
# from earcutr, not to be depended on.
earcut = { version = "0.4", optional = true }

# 2D polygon boolean operations for profile-level void subtraction
i_overlay = "8.0"

# Core IFC parsing
ifc-lite-core.workspace = true

# Math library
nalgebra.workspace = true

# Parallel processing
rayon.workspace = true

# Fast hashing
rustc-hash.workspace = true

# Serialization for the public GeometryDiagnostics contract (already present in
# the wasm tree transitively via ifc-lite-processing; no new bundle weight).
serde.workspace = true

# PNG decode for IfcBlobTexture (issue #961). Already in the dependency tree
# (transitive), so it adds no new wasm weight. Pure-Rust inflate
# (miniz_oxide / fdeflate) — wasm-safe.
png.workspace = true

# JPEG decode for IfcBlobTexture with RasterFormat 'JPG'/'JPEG' (issue #961).
# `default-features = false` drops the `rayon` parallelism (no threads on
# wasm32) — pure-Rust, wasm-safe. ~adds a small decoder to the bundle.
jpeg-decoder = { version = "0.3", default-features = false }

# Small vector optimization for frequently allocated small collections
smallvec = "1.13"

# Error handling
thiserror.workspace = true

# Structured diagnostics, only behind the `observability` feature (dep:tracing
# keeps it out of default builds entirely). The version comes from the workspace,
# whose entry has `default-features = false` and forces nothing on a crate that
# does not enable `observability`. ifc-lite-processing already depends on
# tracing unconditionally, so enabling the feature adds no new crate to
# consumers that use both.
tracing = { workspace = true, optional = true, features = ["std", "attributes"] }

# Pure-Rust CSG kernel (`kernel/`) — exact geometric predicates.
# geometry-predicates: Shewchuk adaptive predicates + the public expansion
# primitives (two_sum/two_product/scale_expansion_zeroelim) for the indirect
# layer. no_std, no C, wasm-clean, FMA-free (platform-deterministic signs).
geometry-predicates.workspace = true
# Exact BigRational oracle + the predicate cascade's exact fallback tier
# (already transitive; promoted to direct).
num-rational = { version = "0.4", default-features = false, features = ["num-bigint"] }
num-traits = { version = "0.2", default-features = false }
bnum = { version = "0.14.4", features = ["numtraits"] }

[dev-dependencies]
# Test-only (publish = false). Path-only: cargo strips it when packaging.
ifc-lite-testkit = { path = "../testkit" }
approx = "0.5"
# The real clash engine, used ONLY by tests/clash_intersection_real_model.rs to
# produce the same candidate pairs the product reports, so the intersection-solid
# measurements are taken on genuine clash pairs rather than a test-local
# broad-phase approximation. `ifc-lite-clash` has zero dependencies and does not
# depend on this crate, so this is not circular and adds nothing to a shipping
# build.
ifc-lite-clash.workspace = true
# JSON serialization for the GeometryDiagnostics camelCase-contract test (asserts
# the serde rename_all keys match the @ifc-lite/geometry TS interface).
serde_json.workspace = true
# Property-based testing for the CSG kernel invariants
# (tests/csg_property_test.rs): volume bounds, NaN-freedom, watertightness
# over bounded randomized inputs. Case counts are set explicitly per
# property to keep the suite fast.
proptest = "1.6"
# Snapshot testing for the geometry correctness harness
# (tests/geometry_correctness_harness.rs). Plain string snapshots only, so
# no serde-format features are needed. Accept intentional geometry changes
# with `cargo insta review`.
insta = { version = "1.43", default-features = false }
# Shewchuk adaptive exact geometric predicates (sign-exact, no_std, no C deps).
# Used by the cross-platform determinism floor test that underpins the
# pure-Rust CSG kernel. Dev-only: not linked into the shipping crate.
robust = "1.2"

[[example]]
name = "color_extraction_test"
path = "examples/color_extraction_test.rs"

# Geometry inherits the workspace numeric-safety policy (restated here, since a
# member cannot both inherit and extend `[lints]`) and additionally allows the
# structure lints that fire pervasively in a numerics kernel and are intentional
# here. These structure allows are deliberately NOT workspace-wide, so the parser,
# server, and exporters stay strict on them.
[lints.clippy]
excessive_precision = "allow"
manual_range_contains = "allow"
manual_clamp = "allow"
neg_cmp_op_on_partial_ord = "allow"
approx_constant = "allow"
type_complexity = "allow"
too_many_arguments = "allow"
large_enum_variant = "allow"
needless_range_loop = "allow"
should_implement_trait = "allow"

[package]
name = "ifc-lite-processing"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
repository.workspace = true
description = "Shared IFC processing pipeline and types used by server and FFI"
keywords = ["ifc", "bim", "geometry", "pipeline", "aec"]
categories = ["parsing", "algorithms"]
readme = "../../README.md"

[features]
# Fixed-size work counters for the diagnostic example, never enabled by default.
opening-perf-trace = ["ifc-lite-geometry/opening-perf-trace"]
# Measurement-only: enable the geometry crate's CSG corpus capture so the
# `csg_scaling_bench` example can replay real void-cut jobs. See
# rust/processing/examples/csg_scaling_bench.rs.
csg-capture = ["ifc-lite-geometry/csg_capture"]
# Structured diagnostics in the geometry crate: routes its production
# warn/debug messages through `tracing` (this crate already depends on
# tracing unconditionally, so the flag only affects ifc-lite-geometry).
# Enabled by the native server; default OFF keeps wasm/default builds
# byte-identical.
observability = ["ifc-lite-geometry/observability"]
# Measurement-only: one never-inlined marker call per ProcessingStats timer
# edge, so `scripts/perf/instructions.sh` can split callgrind instruction
# counts by phase (#6958). Default OFF compiles the markers to nothing.
phase-markers = []

[[example]]
name = "csg_scaling_bench"
required-features = ["csg-capture"]

[dependencies]
ifc-lite-core.workspace = true
# CSG runs on the pure-Rust exact kernel inside ifc-lite-geometry on every
# target (the Manifold C++ kernel was removed in the kernel consolidation —
# see docs/architecture/geometry-pipeline.md).
ifc-lite-geometry.workspace = true
rayon.workspace = true
serde = { workspace = true, features = ["rc"] }
serde_json.workspace = true
png.workspace = true
rustc-hash.workspace = true
tracing = { workspace = true, features = ["std", "attributes"] }
sha2.workspace = true
nalgebra.workspace = true

[dev-dependencies]
# Test-only (publish = false). Path-only: cargo strips it when packaging.
ifc-lite-testkit = { path = "../testkit" }
# `test_support::recv_or_diagnose` only - the shared worker watchdog, so the
# deadlock regression here diagnoses a worker panic the same way the geometry
# suites do instead of carrying its own copy of the two-arm match. Already a
# normal dependency of this crate; the feature is test-only.
ifc-lite-geometry = { workspace = true, features = ["test-support"] }

[lints]
workspace = true

earcutr = "0.5"
# Differential oracle only, behind `triangulation-alt`. Present to be DIFFERENT
# from earcutr, not to be depended on.
earcut = { version = "0.4", optional = true }

# 2D polygon boolean operations for profile-level void subtraction
i_overlay = "8.0"

# Core IFC parsing
ifc-lite-core.workspace = true

# Math library
nalgebra.workspace = true

# Parallel processing
rayon.workspace = true

# Fast hashing
rustc-hash.workspace = true

# Serialization for the public GeometryDiagnostics contract (already present in
# the wasm tree transitively via ifc-lite-processing; no new bundle weight).
serde.workspace = true

# PNG decode for IfcBlobTexture (issue #961). Already in the dependency tree
# (transitive), so it adds no new wasm weight. Pure-Rust inflate
# (miniz_oxide / fdeflate) — wasm-safe.
png.workspace = true

# JPEG decode for IfcBlobTexture with RasterFormat 'JPG'/'JPEG' (issue #961).
# `default-features = false` drops the `rayon` parallelism (no threads on
# wasm32) — pure-Rust, wasm-safe. ~adds a small decoder to the bundle.
jpeg-decoder = { version = "0.3", default-features = false }

# Small vector optimization for frequently allocated small collections
smallvec = "1.13"

# Error handling
thiserror.workspace = true

# Structured diagnostics, only behind the `observability` feature (dep:tracing
# keeps it out of default builds entirely). The version comes from the workspace,
# whose entry has `default-features = false` and forces nothing on a crate that
# does not enable `observability`. ifc-lite-processing already depends on
# tracing unconditionally, so enabling the feature adds no new crate to
# consumers that use both.
tracing = { workspace = true, optional = true, features = ["std", "attributes"] }

# Pure-Rust CSG kernel (`kernel/`) — exact geometric predicates.
# geometry-predicates: Shewchuk adaptive predicates + the public expansion
# primitives (two_sum/two_product/scale_expansion_zeroelim) for the indirect
# layer. no_std, no C, wasm-clean, FMA-free (platform-deterministic signs).
geometry-predicates.workspace = true
# Exact BigRational oracle + the predicate cascade's exact fallback tier
# (already transitive; promoted to direct).
num-rational = { version = "0.4", default-features = false, features = ["num-bigint"] }
num-traits = { version = "0.2", default-features = false }
bnum = { version = "0.14.4", features = ["numtraits"] }

[dev-dependencies]
# Test-only (publish = false). Path-only: cargo strips it when packaging.
ifc-lite-testkit = { path = "../testkit" }
approx = "0.5"
# The real clash engine, used ONLY by tests/clash_intersection_real_model.rs to
# produce the same candidate pairs the product reports, so the intersection-solid
# measurements are taken on genuine clash pairs rather than a test-local
# broad-phase approximation. `ifc-lite-clash` has zero dependencies and does not
# depend on this crate, so this is not circular and adds nothing to a shipping
# build.
ifc-lite-clash.workspace = true
# JSON serialization for the GeometryDiagnostics camelCase-contract test (asserts
# the serde rename_all keys match the @ifc-lite/geometry TS interface).
serde_json.workspace = true
# Property-based testing for the CSG kernel invariants
# (tests/csg_property_test.rs): volume bounds, NaN-freedom, watertightness
# over bounded randomized inputs. Case counts are set explicitly per
# property to keep the suite fast.
proptest = "1.6"
# Snapshot testing for the geometry correctness harness
# (tests/geometry_correctness_harness.rs). Plain string snapshots only, so
# no serde-format features are needed. Accept intentional geometry changes
# with `cargo insta review`.
insta = { version = "1.43", default-features = false }
# Shewchuk adaptive exact geometric predicates (sign-exact, no_std, no C deps).
# Used by the cross-platform determinism floor test that underpins the
# pure-Rust CSG kernel. Dev-only: not linked into the shipping crate.
robust = "1.2"

[[example]]
name = "color_extraction_test"
path = "examples/color_extraction_test.rs"

# Geometry inherits the workspace numeric-safety policy (restated here, since a
# member cannot both inherit and extend `[lints]`) and additionally allows the
# structure lints that fire pervasively in a numerics kernel and are intentional
# here. These structure allows are deliberately NOT workspace-wide, so the parser,
# server, and exporters stay strict on them.
[lints.clippy]
excessive_precision = "allow"
manual_range_contains = "allow"
manual_clamp = "allow"
neg_cmp_op_on_partial_ord = "allow"
approx_constant = "allow"
type_complexity = "allow"
too_many_arguments = "allow"
large_enum_variant = "allow"
needless_range_loop = "allow"
should_implement_trait = "allow"

rust/processing/Cargo.toml.text:
# This Source Code Form is subject to the terms of the Mozilla Public
# License, v. 2.0. If a copy of the MPL was not distributed with this
# file, You can obtain one at https://mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/.

[package]
name = "ifc-lite-processing"
version.workspace = true
edition.workspace = true
authors.workspace = true
license.workspace = true
repository.workspace = true
description = "Shared IFC processing pipeline and types used by server and FFI"
keywords = ["ifc", "bim", "geometry", "pipeline", "aec"]
categories = ["parsing", "algorithms"]
readme = "../../README.md"

[features]
# Opt-in alternate triangulator oracle for canonical producer regression tests.
triangulation-alt = ["ifc-lite-geometry/triangulation-alt"]
# Fixed-size work counters for the diagnostic example, never enabled by default.
opening-perf-trace = ["ifc-lite-geometry/opening-perf-trace"]
# Measurement-only: enable the geometry crate's CSG corpus capture so the
# `csg_scaling_bench` example can replay real void-cut jobs. See
# rust/processing/examples/csg_scaling_bench.rs.
csg-capture = ["ifc-lite-geometry/csg_capture"]
# Structured diagnostics in the geometry crate: routes its production
# warn/debug messages through `tracing` (this crate already depends on
# tracing unconditionally, so the flag only affects ifc-lite-geometry).
# Enabled by the native server; default OFF keeps wasm/default builds
# byte-identical.
observability = ["ifc-lite-geometry/observability"]
# Measurement-only: one never-inlined marker call per ProcessingStats timer
# edge, so `scripts/perf/instructions.sh` can split callgrind instruction
# counts by phase (#6958). Default OFF compiles the markers to nothing.
phase-markers = []

[[example]]
name = "csg_scaling_bench"
required-features = ["csg-capture"]

[dependencies]
ifc-lite-core.workspace = true
# CSG runs on the pure-Rust exact kernel inside ifc-lite-geometry on every
# target (the Manifold C++ kernel was removed in the kernel consolidation —
# see docs/architecture/geometry-pipeline.md).
ifc-lite-geometry.workspace = true
rayon.workspace = true
serde = { workspace = true, features = ["rc"] }
serde_json.workspace = true
png.workspace = true
rustc-hash.workspace = true
tracing = { workspace = true, features = ["std", "attributes"] }
sha2.workspace = true
nalgebra.workspace = true

ifc-lite-geometry-runtime = { path = "../geometry-runtime" }

[dev-dependencies]
# Test-only (publish = false). Path-only: cargo strips it when packaging.
ifc-lite-testkit = { path = "../testkit" }
# `test_support::recv_or_diagnose` only - the shared worker watchdog, so the
# deadlock regression here diagnoses a worker panic the same way the geometry
# suites do instead of carrying its own copy of the two-arm match. Already a
# normal dependency of this crate; the feature is test-only.
ifc-lite-geometry = { workspace = true, features = ["test-support"] }

[target.'cfg(target_arch = "wasm32")'.dev-dependencies]
wasm-bindgen-test = "=0.3.76"
wasm-bindgen-futures = "=0.4.76"
rayon-core = { version = "1", features = ["web_spin_lock"] }

[lints]
workspace = true
